news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems CEO and Director Exercise Stock Options
news.summary: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercised a fully-vested option for 1,402 shares at a $0.75 strike on July 22, and director Richard S. Kollender exercised options for 3,508 shares at the same price on July 24, ahead of the options' expiration; no shares were sold in either filing.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems confirmed it will report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 7, 2026, followed by a management webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems (RPID) shares down roughly 11-12% since Q1 miss as investors weigh MilliporeSigma tie-up and onshoring trend
news.summary: Trefis noted RPID stock had fallen roughly 11-12% between March 31 and July 13, 2026, largely driven by a lower price-to-sales multiple following the disappointing Q1 2026 report, while pointing to the MilliporeSigma global distribution partnership and pharma reshoring/automation demand as potential 2026 growth drivers.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 60,000 restricted stock units of Class A common stock to a newly hired employee as a material inducement to employment, with the award vesting in three equal annual installments.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems will report second-quarter 2026 results before market open with an 8:30 a.m. ET webcast; investors will watch system placement pace, cash burn, and progress toward full-year guidance after Q1's revenue beat but wider-than-expected net loss.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue and placement guidance
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to $37M-$41M total revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements for 2026 with roughly 20% gross margin; the August 7 Q2 print will show whether the company is tracking to this range.

catalysts.label: MilliporeSigma distribution agreement, year two
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro is in year two of its five-year global co-exclusive distribution and collaboration agreement with MilliporeSigma (running roughly March 2026-February 2027), under which MilliporeSigma has a stated commitment to purchase Growth Direct systems; incremental orders under this plan year are a potential upside catalyst.

catalysts.label: Follow-on orders from anchor pharma accounts
catalysts.detail: Following large multi-system expansion orders from Amgen (Q4 2025) and Samsung Biologics (Q1 2026), additional follow-on orders from these and other big-pharma customers as they continue rolling out Growth Direct across sites remain a potential upside catalyst.

pulse: Rapid Micro Biosystems is a small-cap pharma-automation name (Growth Direct microbial QC platform) that has traded weakly since a disappointing Q1 2026 report, with shares down roughly 11-12% since March even as MilliporeSigma's global distribution partnership and pharma reshoring/automation demand are cited as potential 2026 tailwinds. News flow over the past six weeks has been light and largely administrative -- a routine employee inducement grant and insider option exercises by the CEO and a director, alongside confirmation of the Q2 report date -- with the August 7, 2026 earnings release (just days away) the next real test of whether system placement momentum and the MilliporeSigma ramp are translating into progress toward full-year guidance of $37M-$41M revenue.
